# Recorded official XML excerpts — not official or complete copies

These are minimal excerpts of **Metal and Diamond Mining Effluent Regulations (SOR/2002-222)** published by the **Department of Justice Canada** at <https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/XML/SOR-2002-222.xml>.

They reproduce exact provision/table substrings and the original ancestor opening tags. Unrelated siblings are intentionally omitted; neither fixture is a complete law, an official version, or endorsed by the Department of Justice Canada. They are used only for offline structural regression, with no model calls or product publication. Do not seed or activate a source from these files.

`manifest.json` records the full response SHA-256, fragment hashes, original byte ranges, source date attributes and permission/robots checks. The source returned XML `lims:pit-date` and `lims:lastAmendedDate` of `2026-06-04`, and `lims:current-date` of `2026-06-14`; these literal attributes are preserved without substituting dates from the source's HTML landing page or the acquisition clock.

- `ca-sor-2002-222-provisions.xml`: sections 2 and 29; real `Sup`, `Repealed`, original numbering and namespaced commencement/version dates.
- `ca-sor-2002-222-table.xml`: one real schedule table; 14 rows and 13 columns, including the named inserted column `COLSPEC0`. The `col1`–`col12` span covers **13** columns, so subtracting the numeric suffixes is wrong.

Permission basis: the [Reproduction of Federal Law Order](https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/regulations/SI-97-5/) and the Department's [official FAQ](https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/FAQ/) permit reproduction of enactments and consolidations subject to accuracy and not presenting reproductions as official versions. No government symbols or separately copyrighted third-party material were included. The [officially linked XML repository](https://github.com/justicecanada/laws-lois-xml) also publishes an [Open Government Licence notice](https://github.com/justicecanada/laws-lois-xml/blob/main/LICENSE.md). These research findings do not alter the production source permission matrix.

A second family was checked without bypass: GB-001 `legislation.gov.uk` robots specifies at least five seconds between requests and does not disallow XML. A direct request for a section XML returned HTTP 202 with an empty body. No UK official XML fixture is claimed or fabricated; no reader/proxy, challenge solving, or alternate identity was used.
